text: During a trip, a dark thought can show up that feels like the plain truth about you, like suddenly hating someone you love, or being sure you're a fraud. It's usually not the truth, just the opposite of whatever you were trying so hard to feel, coming into focus. Don't shove the thought down, because it'll just come back louder. Tell the person sitting with you if you want to, but don't go texting your whole family about it at 3 a.m., and don't decide you've got some lifelong disorder either. Just notice the thought and the feeling that came with it. They're intense, sure, but they aren't all of you. Then come back to the room you're in, your body, the person with you, what time it is, and, when you can, to love.
reader: someone tripping who just had a dark thought or feeling about themselves come up, or the friend sitting with them, reading what to do with it right now
